Figure 3: Fertility Transitions Paths Given Different Fertility Bounds {n, n̄}

This figure plots the path of optimal fertility n* as a function of c(e), for a given set of lower and upper fertility bounds, n and n̄. These bounds are chosen to reflect prevailing fertility rates in different historical and modern contexts. Within these bounds, fertility is determined by 1/c(e). See Supplemental Appendix Equation A.1 for the solution to the simplified model.
Red solid line — n_lower = 5 and n_upper = 7 (Africa today)
Blue solid line — n_lower = 4 and n_upper = 7 (historical Europe)
Blue dashed line — n_lower = 0 and n_upper = 2 (Europe today)
Orange dashed line — n_lower = 0 and n_upper = 1 (East Asia today)
Black dotted curve — unconstrained interior optimal fertility path
